name: resume-jd-matcher-mpnet
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-07-27.

benchmarks.name: Spearman, held-out 106 resume/JD pairs
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation' table: 'Spearman (production seed 43)' 0.8163 [0.7396, 0.8638] vs row 'Base model before fine-tuning' 0.6246 / 0.2138. The base row packs Spearman/MAE in one cell; ordering taken from the table's own column order. 106 pairs from 53 postings with zero training overlap; labels are synthetic rubric matches.

benchmarks.name: MAE, held-out 106 resume/JD pairs
benchmarks.config: Same table: MAE 0.1270 [0.108, 0.1462] vs base 0.2138. Lower is better. n=106, so the card's own CIs are wide.
